name: r8-01-stranded-shell-false-proof
title: Round 8: with retention on, the sweep deletes the <call>:process row that main #13917 reads as proof a Shell never started
subtitle: real jar · trial merges 6f5f7f6a + main da224e61 and new head 18c8a418 + main aaf97b86 (same answers) · MySQL 8.4.7 and MariaDB 10.11.18 · retention 30d / scan 3s · 2026-10-12

blocks.label: The chain (main da224e61 + this PR)
lines: >> #13917  hosted-never-started-reconcile.ts  at every Hosted Session open: shell child_run still 'dispatch_started' ->
==         GET /executions/<call>%3Aprocess   404 runtime_execution_not_found (only that) => settleFailed(start_failed, started:false)
==         design premise: 'row absent => execute-admission never happened';  R3: ambiguity is never reported as never-started
>> Broker  findByExecutionCallId runs before any Session check, so the 404 is answered even after the runtime was RELEASED
-- PR      <call>:process is an ordinary qwen_tool_execution row; terminal once the binding is drained -> deleted after max-age
-- guard   executionReferenced: publication / CSI ACK keys only;  childRunUnsettled: false for a top-level Session
!! exposure  background Shell on by default since main #13889; isolation default 'session'; retention itself default off

blocks.label: Merge jar: same seed on both engines (binding drained + RELEASED 40 days ago; <call> and <call>:process SETTLED)
lines: ==                           child_run record                        retention off                retention on, 15 s later
-- s-strand (stranded)       background_shell running  settled=NULL  HTTP=200 state=settled       family deleted -> HTTP=404 runtime_execution_not_found
reconcile: skip (ambiguous)  reconcile: settle start_failed / not_started_proven
++ s-done   (control)        background_shell failed   settled=2     HTTP=200 state=settled       family deleted -> HTTP=404 (correct: already settled)
==   each engine: tick bindings_scanned=2 children_scanned=6 executions_deleted=4 sessions_deleted=2 bindings_deleted=2

blocks.label: Candidate guard clause (+33 lines): keep a binding while a Session owning one of its :process rows has an unsettled child_run
lines: ++ s-strand  kept: binding RELEASED, sessions=1, executions=s-strand-call,s-strand-call:process  -> HTTP=200 state=settled   (both engines)
++ s-done    deleted as before                                                              -> HTTP=404               (both engines)
++ existing guard / race / retention / parity tests 37/37, Checkstyle 0;  Session ids come from harness_session_id, so workspace isolation is covered too

note: Merging does not trigger this (retention ships disabled). Enabling retention before the guard knows about stranded Shell records can turn an ambiguous Shell into a recorded start failure for a command that may have run.
